      "observations": [
        "All 15 owned paths and all 1,385 normal-diff lines were read, including the nine generated modules. The handwritten OpenAPI loader now reads shared component parameters before paths, resolves each operation parameter $ref by its final path component and panics for an unknown key; inline parameters still parse directly. The extracted Parameter retains its query location as r#in. A present malformed map still panics, while get_and_parse defaults absent sections, including paths, to empty. This is not a general external-reference resolver.",
        "The generator enables selection/filter support only when both the exact parameter name and in=query match. It threads filterable through bodyless/bodyful request definitions, fields, defaults, URI rendering and a Filter trait implementation. All six changed collection/delta Get methods receive FilterQuery and Filter; the three changed singleton Get methods only move Selection imports and use optional selection pairs. Generated code is inspected output evidence, not a fresh regeneration or server-support check.",
        "pub mod odata exposes the new module while the root retains public Filter: Operation; odata members are not newly re-exported at the root. Selection moves into that module and pair returns None when empty. FilterQuery holds one optional expression; set replaces it, and pair omits an unset filter. The owned URI template always formats path?params for selectable/filterable requests, even when the parameters are empty; accepted generated code later avoids the empty question mark and adds expansion/page-size behavior.",
        "FilterIdentifier validates nonempty ASCII identifiers of at most 128 bytes, with an alphabetic/underscore first byte and only alphanumeric/underscore continuation. It supports borrowed static values and owned String conversion through the same validator. The macro calls the const-capable constructor and panics on error; its body does not itself force a const-evaluation context, so the compile-time JSDoc should not be generalized into guaranteed compile-time rejection for every invocation.",
        "FilterOperand covers null, owned strings, Boolean values and i64 integers. Display doubles string apostrophes and adds quotes; FilterExpression supports Eq plus boxed And/Or and deliberately adds parentheses. These are then passed through form_urlencoded::Serializer by request generation. This is a small grammar and local encoding contract, not validation that an identifier/property/value is accepted by a real Graph endpoint or support for arbitrary OData expressions.",
        "The four owned odata tests contain five assert_eq calls: two selection-pair assertions, one nested-expression string, one existing selected /me URI and one encoded folder-message delta filter URI. All five lack nonempty expected-behavior messages, including the moved existing tests. They do not test apostrophe escaping, invalid identifier branches, empty selection/filter omission, repeated filter replacement or a real request. No new Rust compile/test/generator run occurred.",
